subject: Onboarding certification artifacts & test-results pipeline
messages:
From: Tom Chen <tchen@fastretail.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@fastretail.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Initial performance criteria and coordinate load window

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. To get the onboarding benchmark moving on our side, here's what we need to lock down from Redwood:

- Clear latency targets: 95p < 350ms for text-generation OK; 99p < 700ms for long prompts (2k tokens)
- Throughput expectations: sustained 450 req/s (mixed payloads, average 256 tokens) with headroom for 650 req/s burst
- Test window: we'd like a 4-hour soak followed by a 1-hour peak run during our low-traffic window (UTC 02:00–07:00) on Aug 29
- Evidence we can consume: per-route token histogram, KV cache hit-rate, and per-call token cost snapshot

I'll attach our baseline telemetry and a copy of the dataset we'll use for synthetic replay. Please confirm the preferred Collector and file formats for results.

Tom
Ops Lead, FastRetail

Attachments: fastretail-baseline-traffic.csv (26KB), sample-prompts.json (14KB)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Chen <tchen@fastretail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 13:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial performance criteria and coordinate load window

Tom — thanks, this is helpful. Confirming Redwood can run the soak + peak window on Aug 29 and we'll deliver the artifacts you asked for. Highlights / clarifications:

- Latency SLA targets: we will validate 95p < 300ms for short prompts (<=512 tokens) and 99p < 650ms for long prompts (<=2k tokens). If we miss, we'll surface root cause and mitigation plan.
- Throughput: we'll target sustained 500 req/s with a configured batch size of 8 on our serving cluster (NVIDIA A100 reserved pool).
- Cache warmup: we'll run a 45-minute prefix-warm phase to prime KV cache before the soak.
- Metrics we will provide: per-request latency (p50/p95/p99), model-level token throughput, batch utilization, worker CPU/GPU load, and tail-latency CPU stacks for flagged samples.

Attachments I'm sending now: fastretail-onboard-testplan-v1.xlsx (test matrix + step-by-step playbook), jmeter-loadscript.jmx (synthetic replay). Please confirm your CLA access for the Grafana link so we can share live dashboards.

Next steps:
- You confirm the test dataset and run window today.
- Monica will coordinate the run and post initial raw CSVs to the Drive link.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: fastretail-onboard-testplan-v1.xlsx (220KB)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Onboarding certification artifacts & test-results pipeline

Team — planning note and internal checklist before we run:

1) Infra prep (Dev): verify reserved A100 pool 12x, node affinity set, autoscaler disabled for test window. (Dev: confirm by EOD 26th)
2) Traffic synthesis: convert FastRetail sample-prompts.json into our JMeter thread groups; use variable token lengths (25%, 50%, 25% long).
3) Warm phase: 45 minutes at 60% target QPS to populate KV cache and warm compilation caches.
4) Soak: 4 hours at sustained 500 req/s. Collect per-second latency and model token counters.
5) Peak: 1 hour ramp to 650 req/s (10s ramp steps), capture p99 tail and server-side queue depth.
6) Failover run: short 30-min run with fallback policy enabled to validate graceful degradation.
7) Deliverables: run-20260829-results.csv, run-20260829-grafana-snapshot.png, run-20260829-artifact-manifest.json

I'll be the run lead and will post play-by-play to the shared Drive folder. Dev — please upload the final jmeter script after your conversion and note the seed for reproducibility. Karthik — plan to monitor model quantization profile and log any dynamic kernel changes.

Monica
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: jmeter-loadscript.jmx (converted by Dev will be uploaded)

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 29 Aug 2026 06:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Onboarding certification artifacts & test-results pipeline

Run summary (raw): we executed the planned sequence against FastRetail's designated dataset during UTC 02:00–07:00 (local Aug 29). Key configuration: 12 A100s, batch_size=8, max_concurrency=1200, prefix_warm=2700s.

Observations:
- Warm phase: cache hit-rate reached 78% after ~28 minutes.
- Soak: sustained 520 req/s average; p95 latency 312ms (short prompts), p99 latency 680ms on 2k-token prompts (we saw tail spikes correlated with tenant GC on node-5).
- Peak: transient queue depth increased on node-5 at ramp step 4 causing 2x latency spike for ~45s; we triggered automatic fallback to variant small-quant model for affected requests and continued run.
- Failover: fallback policy executed cleanly and average degradation < 18% for p95 across the run.

Artifacts uploaded: run-20260829-results.csv, run-20260829-grafana-snapshot.png, run-20260829-error-samples.json (samples where p99 > 700ms). Link: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abc123/fastretail-load-run-20260829

I'll post cleaned CSV and a short RCA by EOD.

— Dev
SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: run-20260829-results.csv (4.1MB), run-20260829-grafana-snapshot.png (1.2MB)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Chen <tchen@fastretail.com>, Priya Rao <priya@fastretail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding certification artifacts & test-results pipeline

Tom / Priya — thank you and congrats, run completed and artifacts are now in the shared Drive. Short executive notes:

- Outcome vs ask: sustained throughput target met (500 req/s baseline exceeded slightly). Short-prompt latency target met (95p < 300ms target narrowly missed at 312ms — we will tune batch scheduling). Long-prompt p99 exceeded the 700ms threshold in a small set of samples due to GC/backpressure on a single node; fallback policy prevented broader customer impact.
- Action items for Redwood: 1) node-5 root-cause RCA (Dev) — investigate GC and memory pressure; 2) batch-scheduler tweak to shave p95 by ~15–20ms (Karthik) — will propose config by Mon; 3) provide signed certification packet and artifact manifest for your compliance team (Jasmine)
- Proposed next touch: a 30-minute readout on Mon Aug 31 at 10:00 PT to walk the CSV, Grafana snapshots, and proposed config changes.

Please reply with availability and any other evidence you'd like in the certification packet (e.g., tokenized payload samples or request-level traces).

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: run-20260829-results.csv (uploaded)
